findings.message: ADD COLUMN rewrites users under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE (table rewrite: add column with default before Postgres 11); add the column nullable, backfill in batches, then constrain it
findings.detail: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on users, held for a table rewrite; blocks reads and writes
findings.fix:
-- +mig step: add_users_score_nullable
-- the column arrives nullable and empty: catalog only, no rewrite
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN score int;

-- +mig step: set_users_score_default
-- future rows get the default; existing rows are left to the backfill
ALTER TABLE users ALTER COLUMN score SET DEFAULT 0;

-- +mig step: backfill_users_score
-- +mig backfill: table=users key=id batch=5000
-- +mig satisfied: sql(SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE score IS NULL))
-- batched so each transaction stays short; key=id is assumed, point it at the primary key if that is not right
UPDATE users SET score = 0 WHERE id > :cursor_lo AND id <= :cursor_hi AND score IS NULL;
